from openpyxl import load_workbook

from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/458-49/1_458-49_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/458-49_0_998d4519/1_458-49_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Imported Data"]

# Determine the real used extent in columns A:C.
max_row = 0
for row in range(ws.max_row, 0, -1):
    if any(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value is not None for col in range(1, 4)):
        max_row = row
        break

# Keep the header row and all data rows whose Column C text does NOT end with "L".
kept_rows = []
kept_styles = []
for row in range(1, max_row + 1):
    col_c_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value
    delete_row = row >= 2 and isinstance(col_c_value, str) and col_c_value.endswith("L")
    if not delete_row:
        kept_rows.append([ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value for col in range(1, 4)])
        kept_styles.append([
            {
                "font": copy(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).font),
                "fill": copy(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).fill),
                "border": copy(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border),
                "alignment": copy(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).alignment),
                "number_format": ws.cell(row=row, column=col).number_format,
                "protection": copy(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).protection),
            }
            for col in range(1, 4)
        ])

# Rewrite only columns A:C within the original data extent, shifting kept rows upward.
for out_row in range(1, max_row + 1):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        cell = ws.cell(row=out_row, column=col)
        if out_row <= len(kept_rows):
            cell.value = kept_rows[out_row - 1][col - 1]
            st = kept_styles[out_row - 1][col - 1]
            cell.font = copy(st["font"])
            cell.fill = copy(st["fill"])
            cell.border = copy(st["border"])
            cell.alignment = copy(st["alignment"])
            cell.number_format = st["number_format"]
            cell.protection = copy(st["protection"])
        else:
            cell.value = None

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
